metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: Mean off-diagonal cosine of at most 2048 real item embeddings, mapped from [-1,1] to [0,1]. About 0.5 means zero mean cosine; larger values indicate directional alignment. This does not measure recommendation diversity or unobserved simulator traits. Null means insufficient pairs.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean of (pos_logit - neg_logit) over valid positions; higher means clearer separation.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Counts valid, low-margin and wrong-order positions. Validity requires nonzero input, positive and negative IDs. Category metadata is unavailable, so category breakdowns are null. Margin statistics are null without valid samples. These are conditional sampled training diagnostics, not HR@10 or full-catalog ranking measurements.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:padding_localization: Eval-mode numerical comparisons on at most the first 32 cached rows, with dropout disabled and original module mode restored. No sampling RNG is consumed. All aligned valid positions are compared with individual unpadded execution and direct unpadded native GRU recurrence. Additional comparisons cover extra leading padding, reversed batch order, repeated execution, exact zero padding outputs, all-empty outputs/readouts, maximum-nonpadding-index readout, production candidate scores and causal prefixes. Candidate IDs are the first at most 32 real catalog IDs; they are numerical controls, not an unseen recommendation evaluation. Each comparison reports element counts, nonfinite counts, maximum absolute and relative errors, failures of the absolute threshold and failures of abs(a-b)<=atol+rtol*abs(b). Absolute tolerance is 1e-5 and separately declared relative tolerance is 1e-4; exact-zero controls use zero tolerances. Relative error divides by max(abs(reference),1e-12). padding_check_passed requires every absolute comparison to pass and no nonfinite elements; no real input positions yields null. These finite-sample checks localize discrepancies but do not prove recurrence correctness. A CUDA-only discrepancy does not establish a semantic encoding defect. The separate float64 CPU reference uses identical unfitted GRU and GRUCell parameters, disabled dropout, fixed continuous inputs, nonzero initial states, unsorted/tied lengths, singleton/full histories and internal gaps. It compares aligned outputs, every layer's final state, a common scalar loss, continuous-input gradients, initial-state gradients and every GRU parameter gradient using atol=1e-9 and rtol=1e-7. Padding input gradients are checked against zero with atol=1e-9. All-empty packing gradients are explicitly excluded. This reference does not test the production scatter implementation's gradients or stochastic training equivalence. Checkpoint/export comparisons and validation ranking effects remain unmeasured and null. The supplied canonical production encoder, predictor writer, sampler, loss, optimizer and checkpoint selection are retained. No correction arm or validation improvement is claimed, and no predictors are combined.
